_comment: Russian overlays, joined to articles.json, hubs.json and pages.json by
`source`. Prose only: paths, canonicals, hreflang, JSON-LD structure, og
tags, next-step URLs and the rendered date all come from the English
record, and setting one here is a build error.
source_hash and source_meta_hash pin what each translation was made from,
so editing the English copy fails the build until the Russian catches up.
The website translation guidelines live in the private atlasdays-internal
repo, as TRANSLATION_GUIDELINES-web.md. Read them before editing anything
here, including its section 8 entry for Russian.
Never hand-write a hash. Register records with the pass helper, which
computes both from the English record itself.
